name: Clockwork Lift
story: Tock needs the last gear raised to the clock. Build the lift on its two alternating tracks.
objective: Lock 10 supported slabs above the foundation before the timer ends.
twist: The pendulum pulse changes slide speed; two magnet charges can rescue a close landing.
rule: Time 10 slab drops, alternate both slide directions, and keep enough overlap to support the tower.
controls: Space / tap: lock. U or E: use one of two magnet charges inside the blue snap guide. Watch each slide's rhythm before locking. Magnet locks break the perfect streak.
